user.title: Dynamic Heating Control
user.description: Choose the thermostat, room temperature sensor and schedule helper. Control stays disabled after setup.

data.window_temperature: Temperature while window is open (°C, optional)
data.calibration: Calibrate setpoint with the room sensor

data_description.person_entities: Comfort heating is allowed when at least one selected person or device tracker is home. Device trackers are recommended for simple home/not-home states.
data_description.enter_home_duration: The home state must remain stable for this long before comfort heating is allowed.
data_description.leaving_home_duration: After the last selected person leaves, wait this long before switching to setback temperature.
data_description.guest_entity: An active guest toggle counts as someone being home.
data_description.proximity_entity: Choose the Home Assistant Proximity distance sensor, for example the distance-to-zone or nearest-distance sensor. Older combined proximity entities remain supported.
data_description.proximity_duration: The direction must continuously point towards home within the configured range for this long before comfort heating is allowed. Changing distance readings do not restart the timer; a direction change or unavailable reading does.
data_description.proximity_distance: Maximum approach distance in meters. Distance values in m, km, miles, feet or yards are normalized to meters before comparison.
data_description.presence_entity: Comfort heating is allowed only while this sensor reports presence and the configured household presence source also allows heating.
data_description.presence_schedule_entity: The presence sensor is used only while this schedule is on. When off, sensor motion is ignored.
data_description.presence_on_duration: Presence must remain on for this long before it is accepted.
data_description.presence_off_duration: After the sensor turns off, keep presence accepted for this long before switching to setback.
data_description.proximity_direction_entity: Choose the matching direction-of-travel sensor. The states towards, arrived, away_from and stationary are understood. For new Proximity entities, select the distance and direction sensors separately.
data_description.proximity_max_age: If the distance sensor has not updated within this duration, its position is considered stale. No new heating decision is made from stale proximity data; a person/guest tracker that already confirms home still takes precedence.
data_description.away_temperature: Setpoint while nobody is home. Leave empty to keep using the setback temperature. Must be lower than the comfort temperature.
data_description.heating_limit_temperature: At or above this outdoor temperature the room stays at the setback temperature, even during comfort periods, and preheating is skipped. Normal heating resumes once it is 1 °C cooler. Uses the outdoor sensor, otherwise the weather entity temperature. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.window_open_delay: Setback starts only after the window stayed open this long. Short airing or a draft does not change the setpoint. 0 = immediately.
data_description.window_close_delay: After closing, the window setback is kept this long so the room air settles. 0 = immediately.
data_description.window_temperature: Own setpoint while a window is open, e.g. 15 °C. Leave empty to use the eco or away temperature as before. Must be below the comfort temperature.
data_description.frost_protection_temperature: No setpoint goes below this value, not even with an open window or while away, e.g. 12 °C. Leave empty to disable. Must be below the comfort temperature.
data_description.heating_season_entity: Switch or sensor for the heating season, e.g. a winter mode. While it is OFF the room is not heated: the setpoint goes to the frost protection temperature or, without one, the thermostat minimum. If the entity is unavailable, heating continues normally. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.additional_climate_entities: Further radiator thermostats of the same room. They get the same setpoint as the main thermostat, like a climate group. An unavailable additional thermostat is skipped; a manual change on any of them pauses control for the room.
data_description.calibration: The thermostat measures right at the radiator. When enabled, its setpoint is shifted by the difference between thermostat and room temperature (like Better Thermostat's target-temperature calibration) so it regulates on the room sensor. The difference is recomputed at most every 10 minutes. Do not enable when the selected thermostat already is a Better Thermostat.

error.eco_must_be_below_comfort: The setback temperature must be lower than the comfort temperature.
error.away_must_be_below_comfort: The away temperature must be lower than the comfort temperature.
error.window_must_be_below_comfort: The open-window temperature must be below the comfort temperature.
error.frost_must_be_below_comfort: The frost protection temperature must be below the comfort temperature.

init.title: 1. Room and heating
init.description: Set the thermostat, room-temperature sensor, comfort schedule and temperature targets. Comfort must be higher than setback.

data.calibration: Calibrate setpoint with the room sensor

data_description.climate_entity: Select the climate entity this room controller may adjust. Avoid running another automation that writes targets to the same thermostat.
data_description.room_temperature_entity: Use a room sensor in °C. The value is used to estimate heat-up and cool-down behaviour.
data_description.schedule_entity: A Home Assistant schedule entity: ON means comfort time. Its next_event is used to plan preheating.
data_description.comfort_temperature: Desired room temperature during active comfort periods.
data_description.eco_temperature: Setback target outside comfort periods, during absence or when a window is open. It must be below the comfort target.
data_description.max_preheat_minutes: Hard limit for how early preheating may start.
data_description.frost_protection_temperature: No setpoint goes below this value, not even with an open window or while away, e.g. 12 °C. Leave empty to disable. Must be below the comfort temperature.
data_description.additional_climate_entities: Further radiator thermostats of the same room. They get the same setpoint as the main thermostat, like a climate group. An unavailable additional thermostat is skipped; a manual change on any of them pauses control for the room.
data_description.calibration: The thermostat measures right at the radiator. When enabled, its setpoint is shifted by the difference between thermostat and room temperature (like Better Thermostat's target-temperature calibration) so it regulates on the room sensor. The difference is recomputed at most every 10 minutes. Do not enable when the selected thermostat already is a Better Thermostat.

presence.title: 2. People and presence
presence.description: Configure who is home and optional indoor presence detection. A guest toggle counts as someone being home. Sensor reaction delays reduce short false triggers.

data_description.person_entities: Comfort is allowed when at least one selected person or device tracker is home. Device trackers with simple home/not_home states are usually most predictable.
data_description.enter_home_duration: The home state must remain stable this long before arrival is accepted.
data_description.leaving_home_duration: Keep the previous home state for this grace period after a departure signal.
data_description.guest_entity: An ON input_boolean or binary sensor counts as someone being home.
data_description.presence_entity: Optional indoor presence or motion sensor. When used with people or proximity, both the household and this sensor must allow comfort heating.
data_description.presence_schedule_entity: The indoor presence sensor is considered only while this schedule is ON. Leave blank to use the sensor all day.
data_description.presence_on_duration: Presence must remain ON for this long before it is accepted.
data_description.presence_off_duration: After OFF, retain the previous presence decision for this long to avoid quick setbacks.
data_description.away_temperature: Setpoint while nobody is home. Leave empty to keep using the setback temperature. Must be lower than the comfort temperature.

geofencing.title: 3. Geo-fencing and location quality
geofencing.description: Choose the distance and direction sensors from the same Proximity zone. Distance is normalized to meters. Old location updates are ignored after the maximum age.

data_description.proximity_entity: Select the distance sensor (for example dist_to_zone or nearest_dist_to_zone). Legacy combined entities are still supported.
data_description.proximity_direction_entity: Select the matching direction sensor from the same Proximity zone. Expected states: towards, arrived, away_from, stationary.
data_description.proximity_distance: The upper distance for an approaching-to-home signal. Comparisons are normalized to meters.
data_description.proximity_duration: Direction must stay towards home and within range for this long. Changing distance readings do not restart the timer; direction/range changes and outages do.
data_description.proximity_max_age: If the distance sensor has not updated within this duration, the location is stale and cannot trigger a new heating decision.

environment.title: 4. Window, outdoor temperature and weather
environment.description: Optional sensors refine safe setback and preheating. A configured window sensor must be available; otherwise no new thermostat target is written.

data.window_temperature: Temperature while window is open (°C, optional)

data_description.window_entity: When ON, setback is enforced. If configured but unavailable, the controller avoids writing a new target.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Optional outdoor sensor used to refine the conservative preheat estimate.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional hourly weather forecast. Sunny daytime conditions can reduce the estimated preheat lead by at most 15 minutes.
data_description.heating_limit_temperature: At or above this outdoor temperature the room stays at the setback temperature, even during comfort periods, and preheating is skipped. Normal heating resumes once it is 1 °C cooler. Uses the outdoor sensor, otherwise the weather entity temperature. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.window_open_delay: Setback starts only after the window stayed open this long. Short airing or a draft does not change the setpoint. 0 = immediately.
data_description.window_close_delay: After closing, the window setback is kept this long so the room air settles. 0 = immediately.
data_description.window_temperature: Own setpoint while a window is open, e.g. 15 °C. Leave empty to use the eco or away temperature as before. Must be below the comfort temperature.
data_description.heating_season_entity: Switch or sensor for the heating season, e.g. a winter mode. While it is OFF the room is not heated: the setpoint goes to the frost protection temperature or, without one, the thermostat minimum. If the entity is unavailable, heating continues normally. Leave empty to disable.
